label: Compliance Check Item
intent: Child of compliance-check for one task (params.currentItem, a tenant-scoped task search result set by the parent loop): find the task's latest text attachment through the public API, read it as evidence text, classify it via agent, route to human review when expired and post a reminder when expiring soon. A task without an attachment has no finding and gets no action.

n-find-evidence.label: Find latest evidence attachment
n-find-evidence.intent: Search the task's text/plain and text/markdown attachments (media type, charset ignored) through the public API (auth, validation, tenant query filter), newest first, one result, so a newer binary attachment does not hide older text evidence. The self-call principal carries a tenant, so the tenant query filter pins the search to it; the filter's tenantId (params.currentItem.tenantId, from the tenant-scoped task search) must match as well and is the only scope for a tenant-less GlobalAdmin or System caller. The document node reads only an id this response returns: evidence reads are system reads, so workflow authoring is GlobalAdmin-only (D-075). A read-only POST sends no idempotency header, so 409, 429 and 503 retry and any other 5xx ends the task on n-failed.

n-has-evidence.label: Task has an attachment?
n-has-evidence.intent: An attachment id in the search page reads it as evidence; an empty page has no evidence and takes the no-finding path.

n-fetch-evidence.label: Fetch evidence text
n-fetch-evidence.intent: Read the latest attachment's bytes through the attachment-backed IDocumentStore (D-075) as UTF-8 text. Evidence must be text/plain or text/markdown; the store refuses any other content type, a missing attachment or an unreachable blob, and the task ends on n-failed.

n-extract.label: Agent extracts expiration
n-extract.intent: Ask the agent to extract an expiration date and produce a compact classification.

config.promptTemplate: Read the evidence for task {{$.params.currentItem.title}}. Return JSON: {"status":"expired|expiringSoon|ok","summary":"<text>"}. Evidence excerpt: {{$.context.evidence}}

n-decide.label: Route by compliance status
n-decide.intent: Expired -> escalate to human review. Expiring soon -> reminder comment. OK or no finding -> no action.

n-escalate.label: Human review of expired evidence
n-escalate.intent: Compliance officer reviews and signs off; 48h SLA with escalation.

n-mark-resolved.label: Mark task resolved
n-mark-resolved.intent: Post a follow-up comment and tag the task as compliance-reviewed.

n-remind.label: Post reminder comment
n-remind.intent: For tasks expiring soon, attach a reminder comment via the public API.

item.Body: Compliance evidence is expiring soon - please refresh.
